overview_description.description: Nine Fives develops electronic test and measurement hardware focused on modernizing radio frequency test equipment. The company provides networked, driverless RF instruments that use built-in interfaces and standard web technologies to reduce setup time and integration overhead. Its products include programmable RF attenuators, SPDT switches, and modular rack-mount chassis that share a common power and data backplane. Nine Fives supports control through a web user interface, REST API, and SCPI commands to fit into both new and legacy automation workflows. The NineVue web application offers centralized configuration, RF path monitoring, and version-controlled rack setups. The company also supplies detailed hardware documentation designed for use with software automation tools and coding agents, enabling integration into automated test environments.
